about.description: 8 Reale is a hidden speakeasy cocktail bar located in Orange Beach, AL. Transporting guests back to the days of Prohibition with a modern twist, it offers expertly crafted cocktails — from classics like the Old Fashioned and Sidecar to contemporary creations featuring fresh, local ingredients — all behind a hidden vaulted door. The experience emphasizes ambiance, secrecy, and bartending craftsmanship.
about.elevator_pitch: A modern Prohibition-era speakeasy tucked behind a hidden vaulted door in Orange Beach, offering expertly crafted cocktails and an atmosphere of mystery and sophistication.
about.insider_tip: Keep an eye on 'Today's Secret Code' on their website — it's likely needed to gain entry to this speakeasy.
